items.title: fix(id-worlds): refuse replication payloads carrying over-version entries at admission (#7970)
items.body: Closes #7970. ## Problem `ReplicationTracker::accept` chained Snapshot/Tail payloads without checking that each entry is admitted by the frame's journal header version — `chain_payload` proved only that every line decodes as a `JournalEntry`. Restore refuses any entry whose `journal_version_required_by` exceeds the journal header version, so a signed, in-range frame could carry an entry its header does not admit (e.g. a `PortalGrantSet`, requires version 10, under a version-1 header): the verified cursor advances over it, the durable receiver commits it, and the replica then refuses its own journal at the next restore — the same brick-at-next-open shape #4486 closed for journal headers. A real writer can never produce this frame (it bumps the header before appending such an entry); this is the writer-bug / forged-stream hole, closed at admission. ## Change - New `validate_payload_entry_versions` in `world/replication.rs`, mirroring the #4486 `validate_payload_journal_header`: for Snapshot/Tail payloads, decode each entry and refuse the first whose `journal_version_required_by` exceeds `envelope.header_version`. - New typed error `ReplicationError::EntryRequiresNewerJournal { required, header }` (the dedicated variant the issue left to the implementer). - Wired into both `accept` (Snapshot and Tail arms, alongside the header check, before any state changes) and `validate_envelope_local`, so the production signer also refuses to produce a frame every receiver would refuse (#6469). ## Tests - New regression test `snapshot_and_tail_payloads_must_not_carry_over_version_entries`, mirroring the #4486 set: over-version snapshot refused with cursor untouched; over-version tail refused after a valid snapshot; production signer returns `None` for the same envelope; control — the same entry under a version-10 snapshot is accepted end to end. - Replication module: 62 passed / 0 failed. Full `id-worlds` suite results in the PR thread / issue note. - `cargo fmt -p id-worlds --check` clean. --- Open in [code]smith · Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need.

items.title: doc(id): state the #4592 replication admission contract in replication.rs (#4593)
items.body:
Phase 3 (closing audit) of design #4592, for issue #4593 (task 14247).

## What

- States the #4592 admission contract verbatim in the pkgs/id/src/world/replication.rs module doc (new 'Admission contract (#4592)' section): a frame is admitted only if its header version names a chain that could exist — inside the restore range JOURNAL_VERSION..=MAX_JOURNAL_VERSION, and, for a snapshot, never lower than the version of the chain the tracker already holds.
- Cross-references the contract from the ReplicationTracker::accept doc comment.
- Documentation only; no behavior change.

## Audit outcome (full inventory posted on issue #4593)

Every WorldCore::restore precondition was dispositioned against accept at origin/main 1cd22df899. Header presence/shape, header world, header version range, per-entry decodability, and payload header agreement (#4486) all hold at accept. Dispositions (b), (c), (d) confirmed with code/test evidence on issue #4593. One confirmed gap: per-entry version requirements (disposition (a)) are enforced at restore (core.rs) but not at accept — filed as follow-up issue #7970, not fixed here per the audit scope.

## Tests

- cargo test -p id --lib world::replication on the laptop (result recorded on issue #4593 / task 14247).
